title: Prakrama 4, Sarga 13. The Favour to the Cowherd
html:
Taking leave of Krishnadasa, the Lord goes to Prayaga, where He sends Sri Rupa to Vrindavana; in Kashi He instructs Sanatana to uncover the lost holy places of Vraja and establish devotion; on the road to Nilachala He drinks buttermilk from a young cowherd and blesses him

Verse 1

ततश्च कृष्णदासेन दर्शितो व्रजमण्डलम्।
वन्दितः परया भक्त्या प्राह तं करुणानिधिः॥१॥

tataśca kṛṣṇadāsena darśito vrajamaṇḍalam|
vanditaḥ parayā bhaktyā prāha taṁ karuṇānidhiḥ||1||

tatah — then; cha — and; krishnadasena — by Krishnadasa; darshitah — shown; vraja-mandalam — the Vraja-mandala; vanditah — honoured; paraya — with supreme; bhaktya — devotion; praha — said; tam — to him; karuna-nidhih — the treasure-house of compassion.

1When Krishnadasa had shown the Lord the Vraja-mandala and had bowed to Him with supreme devotion, the treasure-house of compassion said to him:

Verse 2

यथा मे हृदयं स्निग्धं कृष्णकथारसामृतैः।
तथा ते कृष्णचन्द्रश्च प्रसन्नो भवतु स्वयम्॥२॥

yathā me hṛdayaṁ snigdhaṁ kṛṣṇakathārasāmṛtaiḥ|
tathā te kṛṣṇacandraśca prasanno bhavatu svayam||2||

yatha — as; me — my; hridayam — heart; snigdham — has been softened; krishna-katha-rasa-amritaih — by the nectar of the rasa of the stories of Krishna; tatha — so; te — towards you; krishnachandrah — Krishnachandra; cha — and; prasannah — gracious; bhavatu — may be; svayam — Himself.

2"As the nectar of the rasa of Krishna's stories has softened My heart, so may Krishnachandra Himself be gracious to you."

Verse 3

स आह तव दासोऽहं त्वं कृष्णः श्रीनिकेतनः।
त्वां विना न हि जानीयां यथा तत् कुरु मे प्रभो॥३॥

sa āha tava dāso'haṁ tvaṁ kṛṣṇaḥ śrīniketanaḥ|
tvāṁ vinā na hi jānīyāṁ yathā tat kuru me prabho||3||

sah — he; aha — said; tava — Your; dasah — servant; aham — I; tvam — You; krishnah — Krishna; shri-niketanah — the abode of Shri; tvam — You; vina — apart from; na — not; hi — indeed; janiyam — may I know; yatha — so that; tat — that; kuru — do; me — for me; prabho — O Lord.

3He replied, "I am Your servant, and You are Krishna, the abode of Shri. Make it so, O Lord, that I know no one but You."

Verse 4

तथास्त्विति वरं दत्त्वा तमालिङ्ग्य शचीसुतः।
जगन्नाथं च संस्मृत्य ययौ ब्राह्मणसंवृतः॥४॥

tathāstviti varaṁ dattvā tamāliṅgya śacīsutaḥ|
jagannāthaṁ ca saṁsmṛtya yayau brāhmaṇasaṁvṛtaḥ||4||

tatha astu iti — saying "So be it"; varam — a boon; dattva — giving; tam — him; alingya — embracing; shachi-sutah — the son of Shachi; jagannatham — Jagannatha; cha — and; samsmritya — remembering; yayau — departed; brahmana-samvritah — surrounded by brahmanas.

4Saying "So be it" and granting this boon, the son of Shachi embraced him, and remembering Jagannatha He departed, surrounded by brahmanas.

Verse 5

यमुनातीरमासाद्य प्रयागं पुनरागमत्।
वेणीं स्नात्वा माधवं च दृष्ट्वा तत्र स्थितो हरिः॥५॥

yamunātīramāsādya prayāgaṁ punarāgamat|
veṇīṁ snātvā mādhavaṁ ca dṛṣṭvā tatra sthito hariḥ||5||

yamuna-tiram — the bank of the Yamuna; asadya — reaching; prayagam — to Prayaga; punah — again; agamat — came; venim — in the Veni; snatva — bathing; madhavam — Madhava; cha — and; drishtva — seeing; tatra — there; sthitah — stayed; harih — Hari.

5Reaching the banks of the Yamuna, Hari came again to Prayaga; He bathed in the Veni, saw Madhava1, and stayed there.

Verse 6

तत्र श्रीरूप आगत्य सानुजो जगदीश्वरम्।
ददर्श प्रेमसम्पूर्णो दण्डवत् पतितो भुवि॥६॥

tatra śrīrūpa āgatya sānujo jagadīśvaram|
dadarśa premasampūrṇo daṇḍavat patito bhuvi||6||

tatra — there; shri-rupah — Sri Rupa; agatya — coming; sa-anujah — with his younger brother; jagat-ishvaram — the Lord of the world; dadarsha — saw; prema-sampurnah — full of love; danda-vat — like a rod; patitah — fell; bhuvi — on the ground.

6There Sri Rupa came with his younger brother2; seeing the Lord of the world, full of love, he fell to the ground like a rod.

Verse 7

तमालिङ्ग्य स्वचरणं दत्त्वा तस्य शिरोपरि।
प्राह प्रयाहि मथुरां मदाज्ञां प्रतिपालय॥७॥

tamāliṅgya svacaraṇaṁ dattvā tasya śiropari|
prāha prayāhi mathurāṁ madājñāṁ pratipālaya||7||

tam — him; alingya — embracing; sva-charanam — His own foot; dattva — placing; tasya — his; shira-upari — upon the head; praha — said; prayahi — go; mathuram — to Mathura; mat-ajnam — My command; pratipalaya — carry out.

7The Lord embraced him, placed His own foot upon his head and said, "Go to Mathura and carry out My command:

Verse 8

श्रीराधाकृष्णयोर्लीलां वृन्दावनविभूषिताम्।
व्यक्तीकरिष्यसि तत्र मम प्रीतिर्न संशयः॥८॥

śrīrādhākṛṣṇayorlīlāṁ vṛndāvanavibhūṣitām|
vyaktīkariṣyasi tatra mama prītirna saṁśayaḥ||8||

shri-radha-krishnayoh — of Sri Radha and Krishna; lilam — the pastimes; vrindavana-vibhushitam — that adorn Vrindavana; vyakti-karishyasi — you will make manifest; tatra — there; mama — My; pritih — joy; na — no; samshayah — doubt.

8there you will make manifest the pastimes of Sri Radha and Krishna that adorn Vrindavana. In this lies My joy, have no doubt.

Verse 9

गौडदेशपथे श्रीमज्जगन्नाथस्य दर्शने।
आगमिष्यसि चेन्मह्यं दर्शनं भावि सर्वथा॥९॥

gauḍadeśapathe śrīmajjagannāthasya darśane|
āgamiṣyasi cenmahyaṁ darśanaṁ bhāvi sarvathā||9||

gauda-desha-pathe — by the road through the Gauda country; shrimat-jagannathasya — of glorious Jagannatha; darshane — for the sight; agamishyasi — you will come; chet — if; mahyam — of Me; darshanam — sight; bhavi — will be; sarvatha — by all means.

9And if you come by the road through Gauda3 to see glorious Jagannatha, you will surely see Me as well."

Verse 10

स आह चरणं धृत्वा गच्छेऽहं पदसेवकः।
न हीति भगवान् प्राह गच्छ त्वं मथुरां प्रति॥१०॥

sa āha caraṇaṁ dhṛtvā gacche'haṁ padasevakaḥ|
na hīti bhagavān prāha gaccha tvaṁ mathurāṁ prati||10||

sah — he; aha — said; charanam — the foot; dhritva — holding; gacchhe — may go; aham — I; pada-sevakah — as a servant of the feet; na hi — not so; iti — thus; bhagavan — the Lord; praha — said; gacchha — go; tvam — you; mathuram prati — to Mathura.

10Holding His foot, Rupa said, "Let me go with You as a servant of Your feet." "No," said the Lord, "go to Mathura."

Verse 11

एवमुक्त्वा ययौ कृष्णः काशीं ब्राह्मणवेश्मनि।
स्थितस्तत्रागतः श्रीमान् सनातनः प्रभुप्रियः॥११॥

evamuktvā yayau kṛṣṇaḥ kāśīṁ brāhmaṇaveśmani|
sthitastatrāgataḥ śrīmān sanātanaḥ prabhupriyaḥ||11||

evam — thus; uktva — having said; yayau — went; krishnah — Krishna; kashim — to Kashi; brahmana-veshmani — in a brahmana's house; sthitah — stayed; tatra — there; agatah — came; shriman — glorious; sanatanah — Sanatana; prabhu-priyah — dear to the Lord.

11With these words Krishna went on to Kashi and stayed in the house of a brahmana. There came the glorious Sanatana, dear to the Lord.

Verse 12

तं दृष्ट्वा सहसा कृष्ण उत्थाय परमादरात्।
दृढमालिङ्गनं कृत्वा गद्गदं तमुवाच ह॥१२॥

taṁ dṛṣṭvā sahasā kṛṣṇa utthāya paramādarāt|
dṛḍhamāliṅganaṁ kṛtvā gadgadaṁ tamuvāca ha||12||

tam — him; drishtva — seeing; sahasa — at once; krishnah — Krishna; utthaya — rising; parama-adarat — with great regard; dridha-alinganam — a firm embrace; kritva — giving; gadgadam — in a faltering voice; tam — to him; uvacha ha — said.

12Seeing him, Krishna at once rose with great regard, embraced him firmly and said in a faltering voice:

Verse 13

श्रीकृष्णकरुणां कोऽपि वक्तुं शक्नोति पण्डितः।
या त्वां विषयकूपस्थं समुद्धृत्य बलीयसी॥१३॥

śrīkṛṣṇakaruṇāṁ ko'pi vaktuṁ śaknoti paṇḍitaḥ|
yā tvāṁ viṣayakūpasthaṁ samuddhṛtya balīyasī||13||

shri-krishna-karunam — the mercy of Sri Krishna; ko api — what; vaktum — to describe; shaknoti — can; panditah — scholar; ya — which; tvam — you; vishaya-kupa-stham — who were in the well of sense objects; samuddhritya — lifting out; baliyasi — mighty.

13"What scholar could describe the mercy of Sri Krishna? That mighty mercy has drawn you out of the well of sense objects,

Verse 14

श्रीकृष्णनिकटं नीत्वा तन्माधुर्यमपाययत्।
साधु साध्विति हर्षेण शिक्षयामास तं पुनः॥१४॥

śrīkṛṣṇanikaṭaṁ nītvā tanmādhuryamapāyayat|
sādhu sādhviti harṣeṇa śikṣayāmāsa taṁ punaḥ||14||

shri-krishna-nikatam — near Sri Krishna; nitva — bringing; tat-madhuryam — His sweetness; apayayat — made drink; sadhu sadhu — well done, well done; iti — thus; harshena — joyfully; shikshayam asa — instructed; tam — him; punah — further.

14brought you to Sri Krishna and given you His sweetness to drink. Well done, well done!" And joyfully He instructed him further:

Verse 15

वृन्दावनाय गन्तव्यं भक्तिशास्त्रनिरूपणम्।
लुप्ततीर्थप्रकाशं च तन्माहात्म्यमपि स्फुटम्॥१५॥

vṛndāvanāya gantavyaṁ bhaktiśāstranirūpaṇam|
luptatīrthaprakāśaṁ ca tanmāhātmyamapi sphuṭam||15||

vrindavanaya — to Vrindavana; gantavyam — (you) must go; bhakti-shastra-nirupanam — the exposition of the scriptures of devotion; lupta-tirtha-prakasham — the uncovering of the lost holy places; cha — and; tat-mahatmyam — their glory; api — also; sphutam — clearly.

15"You must go to Vrindavana. To expound the scriptures of devotion, to uncover the lost holy places and to make their glory plain —

Verse 16

कर्तव्यं भवता येन भक्तिरेव स्थिरा भवेत्।
यामाश्रित्य सुखेनैव श्रीकृष्णप्रेममाधुरीम्॥१६॥

kartavyaṁ bhavatā yena bhaktireva sthirā bhavet|
yāmāśritya sukhenaiva śrīkṛṣṇapremamādhurīm||16||

kartavyam — must be done; bhavata — by you; yena — so that; bhaktih — devotion; eva — itself; sthira — firm; bhavet — may become; yam — which; ashritya — taking shelter of; sukhena — blissfully; eva — indeed; shri-krishna-prema-madhurim — the sweetness of love for Sri Krishna.

16this is what you must do, so that devotion may stand firm; taking shelter of it, the connoisseurs of rasa, who can tell the essential from the worthless, blissfully drink for ever the sweetness of love for Sri Krishna."

Verse 17

पिबन्ति रसिका नित्यं सारासारविचक्षणाः।
स आह त्वत्कृपा सर्वफलदा मम पावनी॥१७॥

pibanti rasikā nityaṁ sārāsāravicakṣaṇāḥ|
sa āha tvatkṛpā sarvaphaladā mama pāvanī||17||

pibanti — drink; rasikah — the connoisseurs of rasa; nityam — ever; sara-asara-vichakshanah — discerning the essential from the non-essential; sah — he; aha — said; tvat-kripa — Your mercy; sarva-phala-da — bestowing every fruit; mama — me; pavani — purifying.

17He replied, "Your mercy bestows every fruit and purifies me.

Verse 18

श्रीकृष्णेति त्वयोक्तं च तदेव मनसार्थकम्।
हसन् प्राह हृषीकेशस्त्वमेव बुद्धिसत्तमः॥१८॥

śrīkṛṣṇeti tvayoktaṁ ca tadeva manasārthakam|
hasan prāha hṛṣīkeśastvameva buddhisattamaḥ||18||

shri-krishna — "Sri Krishna"; iti — thus; tvaya — by You; uktam — said; cha — and; tat — that; eva — indeed; manasa — in the mind; arthakam — having its meaning; hasan — laughing; praha — said; hrishikeshah — Hrishikesha; tvam — you; eva — truly; buddhi-sattamah — the best of the wise.

18And when You said 'Sri Krishna', in Your mind it meant the very same."4 Hrishikesha laughed and said, "You are truly the wisest of the wise.

Verse 19

दृष्ट्वा मधुपुरीं वृन्दारण्यमेव पुनर्भवान्।
आयास्यति जगन्नाथदर्शनार्थं मदाज्ञया॥१९॥

dṛṣṭvā madhupurīṁ vṛndāraṇyameva punarbhavān|
āyāsyati jagannāthadarśanārthaṁ madājñayā||19||

drishtva — having seen; madhupurim — Madhupuri; vrindaranyam — Vrindaranya; eva — indeed; punah — again; bhavan — you; ayasyati — will come; jagannatha-darshana-artham — to see Jagannatha; mat-ajnaya — by My command.

19When you have seen Madhupuri and Vrindaranya, you will come again by My command to see Jagannatha."

Verse 20

काशीवासिजनान् सर्वान् कृष्णभक्तिप्रदानतः।
उद्धृत्य कृपया कृष्णो भक्तानां सुखहेतवे॥२०॥

kāśīvāsijanān sarvān kṛṣṇabhaktipradānataḥ|
uddhṛtya kṛpayā kṛṣṇo bhaktānāṁ sukhahetave||20||

kashi-vasi-janan — the people of Kashi; sarvan — all; krishna-bhakti-pradanatah — by granting devotion to Krishna; uddhritya — delivering; kripaya — mercifully; krishnah — Krishna; bhaktanam — of the devotees; sukha-hetave — for the joy.

20Thus, to the joy of His devotees, Krishna mercifully delivered all the people of Kashi by granting them devotion to Krishna;

Verse 21

सनातनं समालिङ्ग्य तपनादीन् यथासुखम्।
जगाम सत्वरं श्रीमान् जगन्नाथदिदृक्षया॥२१॥

sanātanaṁ samāliṅgya tapanādīn yathāsukham|
jagāma satvaraṁ śrīmān jagannāthadidṛkṣayā||21||

sanatanam — Sanatana; samalingya — embracing; tapana-adin — Tapana and the others; yatha-sukham — to their heart's content; jagama — went; satvaram — swiftly; shriman — the glorious one; jagannatha-didrikshaya — wishing to see Jagannatha.

21then the glorious Lord embraced Sanatana, and Tapana5 and the others, to their heart's content, and swiftly departed, eager to see Jagannatha.

Verse 22

एवं स भगवान् कृष्णः पथि गच्छन् कृपानिधिः।
दृष्ट्वा गोपमुवाचेदं सतक्रकलसं प्रभुः॥२२॥

evaṁ sa bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ pathi gacchan kṛpānidhiḥ|
dṛṣṭvā gopamuvācedaṁ satakrakalasaṁ prabhuḥ||22||

evam — thus; sah — He; bhagavan — the Lord; krishnah — Krishna; pathi — on the road; gacchhan — going; kripa-nidhih — the treasure-house of mercy; drishtva — seeing; gopam — a cowherd; uvacha — said; idam — this; sa-takra-kalasam — with a pot of buttermilk; prabhuh — the Lord.

22As He went along the road, the Lord Krishna, the treasure-house of mercy, saw a cowherd with a pot of buttermilk and said to him:

Verse 23

पिपासितोऽहं तक्रं मे देहि गोप यथासुखम्।
श्रुत्वा परमहर्षेण सम्पूर्णकलसं ददौ॥२३॥

pipāsito'haṁ takraṁ me dehi gopa yathāsukham|
śrutvā paramaharṣeṇa sampūrṇakalasaṁ dadau||23||

pipasitah — thirsty; aham — I; takram — buttermilk; me — to Me; dehi — give; gopa — O cowherd; yatha-sukham — as you please; shrutva — hearing; parama-harshena — with great joy; sampurna-kalasam — the full pot; dadau — he gave.

23"I am thirsty. Give Me some buttermilk, cowherd, as much as you please." Hearing this, the cowherd joyfully gave Him the full pot.

Verse 24

हस्ताभ्यां कलसं धृत्वा सतक्रं भक्तवत्सलः।
पीत्वा गोपकुमाराय वरं दत्त्वा ययौ हरिः॥२४॥

hastābhyāṁ kalasaṁ dhṛtvā satakraṁ bhaktavatsalaḥ|
pītvā gopakumārāya varaṁ dattvā yayau hariḥ||24||

hastabhyam — with both hands; kalasam — the pot; dhritva — holding; sa-takram — with the buttermilk; bhakta-vatsalah — loving to His devotees; pitva — having drunk; gopa-kumaraya — to the cowherd boy; varam — a boon; dattva — giving; yayau — went on; harih — Hari.

24Holding the pot of buttermilk in both hands, Hari, who loves His devotees, drank, gave the young cowherd a blessing and went on His way.

Thus ends the thirteenth sarga, "The Favour to the Cowherd" (Gopa-anugraha), of the fourth prakrama of the poem "Sri Krishna-chaitanya-charitamrita."

✦

Notes

  1. The Veni is the Triveni, the confluence of the Ganga, the Yamuna and the Sarasvati at Prayaga; Madhava is Veni-Madhava, the presiding Deity of Prayaga.
  2. Sri Rupa's younger brother was Anupama (Vallabha).
  3. Gauda: Bengal.
  4. The sense is uncertain. Sanatana apparently understood that in speaking of Sri Krishna's mercy (v. 13) the Lord meant Himself; hence His laughter.
  5. Tapana Mishra, the devotee in whose house the Lord stayed at Kashi.
